hardcodes.text: body { margin: 0; font-family: var(--igx-font-family-sans); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; background: var(--igx-semantic-color-background-canvas); color: var(--igx-semantic-color-text-primary); }

.nexus-metric-value { display: block; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: var(--igx-semantic-typography-metric-font-weight); line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-block: var(--igx-spacing-4) var(--igx-spacing-2); }
.nexus-overview-summary dd strong { display: block; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: var(--igx-semantic-typography-metric-font-weight); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.nexus-label-output svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; background: #fff; }
.nexus-lifecycle-context dd { margin: var(--igx-spacing-1) 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: var(--igx-font-weight-semibold); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.nexus-lifecycle-facts dd { margin: var(--igx-spacing-1) 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: var(--igx-font-weight-semibold); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
